text:
chloe: During the security review I found a set of DB dump files in /mnt/efs/backups/tmp/ that are plaintext. They look like recent nightly dumps.

martin: Wait, tmp? Those should be written encrypted and then deleted. Can you paste ls -l and a sample filename?

chloe: `ls -l /mnt/efs/backups/tmp` shows:```-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 52428800 Mar 20 02:13 tenant42-2026-03-20.sql```
That's world-readable on the EFS mount used by uploader workers.

backup-bot: Note: uploader-1.3.4 job created temp file /backups/tmp/tenant42-2026-03-20.sql at 2026-03-20T02:10:12Z; expected lifecycle: encrypt->upload->shred.

chloe: Also saw a KMS grant in account that allows `arn:aws:iam::999:role/vendor-archive` to kms:Decrypt on our backup key (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/xyz-archive). That role shouldn't have decrypt.

oncall: escalating. This is both a data exposure risk (plaintext temp blobs) and an RBAC overgrant. Marking incident P0.

martin: Can you paste the grant info? Need the GrantId and the principal.

chloe: CloudTrail snippet: ```CreateGrant user=infra-robot principal=arn:aws:iam::111:role/backup-uploader grantee=arn:aws:iam::999:role/vendor-archive operations=[Decrypt,ReEncryptFrom] GrantId=gr-0a1b2c3d```

security-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-900 created (priority=P0) - plaintext temp backups + unauthorized KMS grantee.

martin: Immediate containment steps: 1) revoke the vendor grant, 2) rotate the backup CMK (or disable immediate decrypt), 3) remove plaintext temp files and audit S3 uploads.

chloe: I can rm the tmp files from EFS, but we should preserve evidence first. I've copied checksums to the incident ticket.

backup-bot: Current state: 1) Uploaded objects for tenant42 present in s3://backups-prod/tenant42/2026-03-20/*. 2) uploader job claims encryption used KMS key xyz-archive for S3 server-side encryption (SSE-KMS).

martin: Revoke grant now:```aws kms retire-grant --grant-id gr-0a1b2c3d --key-id xyz-archive```
I'll run revoke and confirm.

oncall: Revoke run: success. Grant gr-0a1b2c3d retired at 2026-03-21T10:02:00Z. Note added to INC-2026-900.

chloe: Deleted tmp files (after evidence copy). Commands:```sudo shred -u /mnt/efs/backups/tmp/tenant42-2026-03-20.sql```Checksums attached.

martin: Next, we need to check whether vendor role performed decrypt before revoke. CloudTrail shows two kms:Decrypt calls by grantee principal at 2026-03-20T03:05Z and 03:07Z on objects s3://backups-prod/tenant42/2026-03-20/obj001. Need to treat as potential data exfiltration.

security-bot: Alert: suspicious outbound network flow from runner archive-uploader-12 around 2026-03-20T03:10Z to IP range owned by vendor. Correlating logs.

auditor-bot: Note: any RBAC revocation must be followed by an approval note and a CAPA (Corrective Action) entry. Please attach mitigations and timeline.

martin: Remediation plan: A) rotate CMK and re-encrypt S3 objects to new key B) run integrity + access audit C) tighten uploader worker filesystem permissions and add ephemeral tmpdir that auto-empties on crash D) add CI guard to prevent granting external principals without two-step approval.

chloe: For CMK rotation I propose creating a new key xyz-archive-v2, update S3 bucket default encryption to use it, then run a controlled `aws s3 cp --sse aws:kms` copy re-encrypt job for the affected prefixes. Example re-encrypt:```aws s3 cp s3://backups-prod/tenant42/2026-03-20/obj001 s3://backups-prod/tenant42/2026-03-20/obj001 --metadata-directive REPLACE --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/xyz-archive-v2```

martin: Good. We should also perform a key policy update to disallow `CreateGrant` to external principals from service accounts without an approval tag. Add IAM condition: allow CreateGrant only if `aws:RequestTag/approved-by` present.

oncall: Action items assigned:
- martin: rotate key + re-encrypt prefix + attach CloudTrail evidence to incident
- chloe: produce CAPA entry and runbook changes for uploader temp file handling
- infra: implement IAM condition on KMS key policy and gate CreateGrant via automation with approval tag
- secops: investigate outbound transfer and vendor access; notify Legal if exfiltration confirmed

auditor-bot: Approval required: all RBAC and key-policy changes must include PR description and reviewer list.

martin: Quick note on re-encrypt scale: we'll run 24h chunked job with checksums; we will not delete original objects until re-encrypt verified.

chloe: Also adding a runtime check in uploader: use secure tmpdir with restrictive umask, and ensure `trap 'rm -f \"$TMPFILE\"' EXIT` in scripts. I'll open PR with unit tests.

security-bot: Incident status -> containment in progress. Evidence attached: CloudTrail snippets, checksums, outbound flow logs.

oncall: Closing loop: grant revoked, tmp files shredded, rotation started. Keeping incident open for forensic evidence and CAPA.

martin: We should also rotate any database credentials that might have been exposed by the tmp dump. I'll coordinate DB creds rotate with app teams.

chloe: Thanks everyone. I'll post the uploader PR link and the runbook diff to INC-2026-900 when ready. :white_check_mark:
